title: Ya ali tera shukriya
body:
Ya ali tera shukriya
<<DIVIDER>>
Shukria ya ALI -4
ALI ALI hum dum ALI ALI ALI ALI-2
ALI MOLA -5
ALI-ALI
ALI ALI hum dum ALI ALI
ALI-2
Sher E KHUDA nafs E KHUDA, Haajat rawa'n mushkil kusha, Karte hain sab NABI AS WALI
Karta hai KIBRIYA
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria-4
<<DIVIDER>>
Padhti hai ye Kabeh ki-2 diwar qaseeda tera.
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria-2
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Ho ik-ik karke sare rishte chod rahe the daaman, Waqt e qaza tha mai tanha tha rukne lagi thi dhadkan, Ay MOLA gar tum nahi aate-2
Maut se mai mar jata.
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria
ALI haq-5
Ya ALI tera shukria-4
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Han isse behtar hamd e KHUDA kya koi bhala likhega, Jisko ALI sajda karta hai khud wo KHUDA kya hoga, Kafi hai Tauheed samajhne ko tera ik sajda.
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria
ALI haq-5
Ya ALI tera shukria-4
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Han Kaabah kahan tha but khana tha aapne rakhli izzat, Wo to kahiye BINT e ASAD ne karli khud hi zehmat, Sehne ABU TALIB me warna Kaabah chal kar aata.
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria
ALI haq-5
Ya ALI tera shukria-4
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Nad e ALI hai inka wazeefa khaibar O khandaq lori, Maut se unko dar nahi lagta maut hai unse darti, Zikr se Tere sher hua hai qaum ka baccha baccha
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria
ALI haq-5
Ya ALI tera shukria-4
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Han ishq e ALI se ZAINABIYA azaad karaya usne, Kya hain ALI k naukar ye dunia ko bataya usne, Japd kahegi qabza karke dunia par HEZBOLLAH
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria
ALI haq-5
Ya ALI tera shukria-4
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Kaise hain ye diwane kyo inko nahi lagta dar, Maut bhi sakte me thi akhir kya hain ALI ke naukar, Dekh k apni maut ko jab ye-2
Sibt e Jafer bola.
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria
ALI haq-5
Ya ALI tera shukria-4
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Masjid me jab nam e KHUDA par bheek kisi ne mangi, Hath badha kar dast e KHUDA ne apni angoothi dedi, Akba sayil se pehle-2
Ye RAB e Akbar bola.
<<MINI>>
Ya ALI tera shukria-4
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya ALI-4
author: Mir Hassan Mir
